title: Retry deployment and restore working public URL for campus-point-services.icp0.io

requirements.text: Perform a fresh Internet Computer deployment that produces a new working public URL in the format `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` and record the newly generated URL in-repo as the latest deployment output.
acceptanceCriteria: A new deployment is produced with a working public URL in the format `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/`.
`frontend/DEPLOYMENT_OUTPUT.md` contains the actual new public URL (no `[canister-id]` placeholder) and the deployment date is updated.
Opening the recorded URL in an incognito/private window loads the app (not 'Error 400 - Canister ID Not Resolved').

requirements.text: Update `frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md` to set the **Current Deployment** public URL to the newly generated working `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL and keep `https://campus-point-services.icp0.io/` listed as the previous/deprecated URL.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md` contains the exact new `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL (no placeholder) under 'Current Deployment'.
`https://campus-point-services.icp0.io/` remains present and clearly labeled as deprecated/previous.
The sitemap URL shown in the doc matches the new deployment URL (`https://[canister-id].icp0.io/sitemap.xml`).

requirements.text: Update `frontend/GOOGLE_INDEXING_GUIDE.md` so the 'Your Live Website URL' section includes the newly generated working `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL and references the correct sitemap URL for that deployment.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/GOOGLE_INDEXING_GUIDE.md` includes the exact new `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL (no placeholder) in the 'Your Live Website URL' section.
The guide’s sitemap URL references the new deployment (`https://[canister-id].icp0.io/sitemap.xml`).

requirements.text: Add documentation for re-attaching the custom ICP0 domain `campus-point-services.icp0.io` so it points to the newly deployed canister (i.e., update the domain mapping/alias to the new canister ID), including a short verification checklist and what to do if the domain still resolves to a deleted/non-existing canister.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository documentation clearly states that `campus-point-services.icp0.io` must be re-mapped to the new canister ID after redeploying.
Documentation includes steps to verify the domain resolves correctly (e.g., open the domain URL, confirm it is not an error page, compare to the new `https://[canister-id].icp0.io/` URL).
Documentation warns that the old domain may currently point to a deleted/non-existing canister and must be updated to the new canister ID to work again.

constraints: Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, or anything in `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Backend must remain single-actor with all Motoko logic in `backend/main.mo`; only create `backend/migration.mo` if an upgrade requires state migration.
Use English for all user-facing documentation and UI text.
nonGoals: Implementing external DNS/provider configuration outside of repository changes (e.g., purchasing a domain or managing third-party DNS accounts).
Adding new product features unrelated to deployment/linking (e.g., new pages, new enquiry workflow changes).
